scope: Delta review of first-wave prerequisite receipts, explicit reviewed two-file fix adoption, exact source history checks and preservation of four mutation/restore phases.

resolved_findings.finding: The earlier first-wave gate did not validate receipt schema.
resolved_findings.resolution: Requires hepta.runtime-convergence-native-validation.v1 plus exact phase/state, source, tested commit, raw receipt hash, original command and exit codes.

resolved_findings.finding: The earlier green gate trusted its own required_tests list and could accept a desktop-only success.
resolved_findings.resolution: The reviewed plan pins the exact full four-package command, 813 run and passed counts, all fourteen original required tests and complete observed passes; the named desktop gate pins one original test.

resolved_findings.finding: Raw fix-blocked must not be converted into an invented fix-complete result.
resolved_findings.resolution: A separate hash-pinned root adoption authorizes only the exact two-file lint scope. The raw fix receipt must retain fix-blocked/exit1 with just-fix exit0, exact two unexpected paths, the full-tree path/patch digests, original thirteen controlled before/after hashes and successful original formatting step.

resolved_findings.finding: git rev-list --parents hides parents at the actual depth-one checkout boundary.
resolved_findings.resolution: The runner reads git cat-file -p HEAD and parses ordered parent headers from the immutable commit object, without fetching, unshallowing or writing the first checkout.

source_checks_in_runner: Current first and second HEAD/tree and exact ordered parents must match the reviewed adoption.
Each old-to-current full-tree delta must contain exactly the two adopted test paths; old and current blobs must match the review.
Both current worktrees must be clean; the first checks use git --no-optional-locks and never mutate it.
The first original thirteen controlled file identities and both adopted tests are checked. The second fixed fourteen ingress files and both adopted tests are checked.
Cargo.lock, original just/test profile contracts, pinned native toolchain and exclusive native lock remain enforced.

mutation_and_recovery_review.extra_protection: check_positive now also verifies the two adopted test files.
mutation_and_recovery_review.restoration: Restore only a production file whose bytes still equal the saved positive or explicitly permitted mutant; reject unexpected changes, recheck all protected files and lockfile, require a clean worktree and unchanged HEAD/tree. Restore/integrity failures keep the phase blocked.

bounded_local_checks: Parsed the final Python source without invoking main or Cargo.
Extracted only pure gate functions and accepted the actual named and 813-test facba receipts with their original states.
Accepted the original raw fix-blocked/exit1 receipt only with the exact separately reviewed adoption.
Verified prior hardened gate rejection of missing schema, desktop-only green, filtered green command and an unreviewed blocked fix.
Used a separate two-commit local Git fixture to confirm rev-list omits shallow parents while cat-file returns the true commit parent. No product checkout was used for that check.
limits: This review does not authorize an unreviewed plan/head or silently advance a branch.
The earlier facba test results remain historical facts about facba; current F/E execution must be recorded under its actual source identity.
Actual native phase preflight, four behavioral negative controls and exact restoration, full three-package green and scoped fix last remain to be executed and independently reviewed.
Original Windows, ordered merge, real provider/effect, durable restart and release gates remain separate.
